OCR Scanner – PDF & Text

Privacy Policy

How the on-device app handles documents, exports and support — and how this website is hosted.

Effective 6 October 2026On-device Android edition
Policy scopeDocuments stay on your deviceCollection and sharingPro purchasesStorage and retentionExports and supportWebsite and hostingYour choices and requestsChanges to this policyFrench and Arabic summaries

Policy scope

This policy describes OCR Scanner – PDF & Text, the on-device Android application with package com.chandra.ocr.offline, and this product website. The purchase disclosures apply from version 1.1.0. Earlier version 1.0.1 has no in-app purchases. This policy does not describe separate cloud or development editions.

The independent publisher of OCR Scanner can be reached at chennoufo11@gmail.com for privacy and support questions.

Documents stay on your device

You select image or PDF files, or capture a page with a camera application. The app copies normalized page images into its private device storage and saves document titles, dates, page adjustments, favorites and recognized text locally.

English and French recognition use bundled Google ML Kit models. Arabic recognition uses bundled Tesseract and its Arabic model. These models are included with the installation. Recognition does not require a user account, model download or internet connection.

Collection and sharing

The on-device app does not upload your documents or recognized text to the publisher, Google, Datalab or another OCR service. It has no advertising or analytics service and no publisher-operated user account. We do not receive document content from this app. The app has internet permission for Samsung in-app purchases; recognition continues to work offline.

Android, camera apps, file providers and applications you choose to use have their own privacy practices. Permissions and access you grant to these services are controlled by your device and those services.

Optional Pro purchase

OCR Scanner Pro is an optional one-time purchase processed through Galaxy Store using Samsung IAP. Product prices, payment, ownership checks and restore requests are handled by Samsung. A Samsung account and internet connection are needed for purchase or restore. We do not receive or store your payment card details.

The SDK receives product details and purchase/ownership identifiers and uses them to unlock Pro and acknowledge delivery to Samsung. It may process account, device, network and transaction information under Samsung’s privacy policy. Document images and recognized text are not included in these purchase requests.

The app stores a device-bound, authenticated Pro entitlement locally, so previously confirmed Pro access can continue offline. Successful ownership checks update this entitlement, including removing it when the store reports no purchase. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes the local cache; use Restore purchases with the same Samsung account to recover eligible purchases.

Storage and retention

Documents, page images and results remain in private device storage until you delete them, clear the app’s data or uninstall it. Android backup of app data is disabled. Android app sandboxing protects the stored files; this app does not add separate database encryption.

The Delete document action stops local processing and removes the saved pages, local OCR job files and the document database entry. Deleting an individual draft page removes that saved page. Temporary capture or processing files may remain after an interrupted operation until document deletion or app storage is cleared.

Exports and support

Sharing and exports happen only when you initiate them through Android’s chooser or file picker. The destination you select receives that content. Exported and shared copies are outside the app and are not deleted when you remove the original document.

If you email chennoufo11@gmail.com, we receive the information and attachments you choose to send and use them to respond to your request. Avoid sending confidential documents. We do not need your scan content to answer ordinary app questions. Your email service and our email provider also process those messages under their own policies. Support correspondence is retained only for responding and any applicable recordkeeping requirements; ask us to delete it when no longer needed.

Website and hosting

This website does not ask you to upload documents, create an app account or provide payment information. We have not added advertising trackers, analytics scripts, contact forms or third-party media embeds. Fonts, screenshots and other page assets are served with the website.

The website’s hosting and security providers, including GitHub Pages and its infrastructure, may process normal connection information such as your IP address, request metadata and browser details for delivery, abuse prevention and security. Provider-managed cookies or access controls may be used by that infrastructure. Their policies govern their own processing. Reading the bundled privacy policy inside the app does not contact this website.

Your choices and requests

You can view, share and delete local documents in the app. You can also clear app storage through Android Settings or uninstall the app. We do not hold a server copy of your offline documents and cannot recover documents deleted from your device.

For questions or requests about information you sent us directly, contact chennoufo11@gmail.com. Depending on where you live, applicable privacy law may provide rights to access, correct or delete that information. We will respond in accordance with applicable requirements.

This app does not request children’s personal information. If a child sends personal information to support, a parent or guardian may contact us to request its removal.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the app or website changes. The effective date will be updated. Material changes to the app’s data handling will be described in the relevant release notes and policy. A later cloud or advertising-enabled edition would need its own accurate disclosures.

French and Arabic summaries

Résumé en français

Les documents, images, réglages, favoris et textes reconnus restent dans le stockage privé de votre appareil. Les modèles sont intégrés ; aucun compte ni accès Internet n’est nécessaire pour la reconnaissance. Cette version ne téléverse pas vos documents et ne contient ni publicité ni service d’analyse. Dès la version 1.1.0, l’achat facultatif de Pro et sa restauration passent par Samsung IAP et nécessitent Internet et un compte Samsung. Aucun numéro de carte n’est conservé par l’application ; le droit Pro est mémorisé localement. Les copies exportées restent sous votre contrôle. Vous pouvez supprimer vos documents dans l’application ou effacer ses données dans les paramètres Android. Le site et les services de messagerie peuvent traiter les informations de connexion et les messages que vous leur envoyez. Contact : chennoufo11@gmail.com.

ملخص بالعربية

تبقى المستندات والصور والإعدادات والمفضلة والنصوص المستخرجة في التخزين الخاص بالتطبيق على جهازك. نماذج التعرف مضمّنة، ولا تحتاج المعالجة إلى حساب أو إنترنت. هذه النسخة لا ترفع مستنداتك ولا تحتوي على إعلانات أو خدمة تحليلات. ابتداءً من الإصدار 1.1.0، يتم شراء Pro الاختياري واستعادته عبر Samsung IAP، ويتطلب ذلك الإنترنت وحساب Samsung. لا يحتفظ التطبيق ببيانات البطاقة، ويحفظ حق الوصول إلى Pro محلياً. تبقى النسخ التي تصدّرها إلى تطبيقات أخرى تحت مسؤوليتك. يمكنك حذف المستندات داخل التطبيق أو مسح بياناته من إعدادات Android. قد تعالج خدمات استضافة الموقع والبريد الإلكتروني معلومات الاتصال والرسائل التي ترسلها. للتواصل: chennoufo11@gmail.com.
